TablePilot 0.3.3 desktop prototype.

## Downloads
- Windows 11 x64: `TablePilot_0.3.3_x64-setup.exe`
- Ubuntu 24.04 / compatible Debian x64: `TablePilot_0.3.3_amd64.deb`
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`: installer checksums.

Installers are unsigned. Native installer builds passed; installation and live database/SSH tests still need user testing.
Downloads and release history are available from this repository.

Source commit: `307860628511f6f3e2d60f50d04327d100cf00cb`.

Changes: Remove Plugin Center navigation and marketplace updates while preserving Driver Manager/JDBC. Use faster prototype build settings and expanded compilation caching.
